ver: Version counter. Starts at 1, incremented on every update.

unit_test.coverage_threshold: Minimum line coverage % required for a screen to be marked done. Default: 80.
unit_test.scope: What is in scope for unit tests (e.g. service layer, business logic, utility functions).
unit_test.mock_policy: What must be mocked in unit tests (e.g. DB, network, external services, time).
unit_test.run_command: Shell command to run unit tests (e.g. 'pytest tests/unit', 'go test ./...', 'cargo test'). Stack-agnostic — enter the exact command for your project.

integration_test.style: Test style. Always 'BDD' in this framework.
integration_test.format: Scenario format. Always 'Gherkin' (Given/When/Then) in this framework.
integration_test.scope: Which endpoints/flows are covered (e.g. all API endpoints).

environment.database: DB strategy for integration tests (e.g. real_test_db, in_memory).
environment.external_services: How external services are handled in integration tests (e.g. mock, sandbox, real).

integration_test.seed_strategy: How test data is created before each test (e.g. factories, fixtures, inline).
integration_test.seed_command: Shell command to seed the test database before integration tests run (e.g. 'make db-seed-test', 'flask seed-test'). Leave empty if seed is handled inside the test framework itself.
integration_test.run_command: Shell command to run integration tests (e.g. 'pytest tests/integration', 'mvn test -Pintegration'). Stack-agnostic.

component_test.framework: Testing framework for UI components (e.g. React Testing Library, Vue Test Utils, Angular Testing Utilities). Derive from arch_spec.tech_stack.frontend. Empty string if no frontend.
component_test.scope: What UI components are in scope (e.g. all interactive components: forms, modals, data-display components with business logic).
component_test.mock_api: Whether API calls are mocked in component tests. Default: true — components are tested in isolation from the backend.
component_test.run_command: Shell command to run component tests (e.g. 'vitest run', 'jest --testPathPattern=component'). Empty string if no frontend.

browser_test.tool: Browser automation tool (e.g. Playwright, Cypress, Selenium). Playwright recommended for new projects.
browser_test.scope: Always 'single-screen' — tests cover one screen at a time. Multi-screen user journey tests are out of scope.
browser_test.environment: Target environment for browser tests (e.g. local dev server, staging server with test database).
browser_test.headless: Run browser in headless mode. Default: true. Set false for debugging.
browser_test.start_command: Shell command to start the full stack (BE + FE + DB) before browser tests run (e.g. 'make start-test', 'docker-compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d'). Leave empty if the server is started manually outside the framework.
browser_test.base_url: URL to health-check after start_command — agent polls this until it responds (200) or times out. Required if start_command is set (e.g. 'http://localhost:3000'). Leave empty if start_command is empty.
browser_test.run_command: Shell command to run browser tests (e.g. 'playwright test', 'cypress run --headless'). Stack-agnostic.

auto_fix.enabled: Whether agent auto-fix is active when tests fail. Default: true.
auto_fix.max_retries: Max auto-fix attempts before agent stops and escalates to user. Default: 5.
auto_fix.on_environment_error: Policy when an environment error is detected (DB not reachable, port conflict). Always 'stop'.
auto_fix.on_spec_mismatch: Policy when a test scenario contradicts the tech spec. Always 'pause' to request user confirmation.
auto_fix.on_implementation_error: Policy when implementation logic fails a test. Always 'auto_fix' up to max_retries.

done_definition.screen_done_when: List of conditions that must all be true for a screen to be marked done.
done_definition.cannot_mark_done_if: List of blocking conditions that prevent a screen from being marked done.
